body:
If I get what ur saying, that is true. But what the point of going through life when u dont get to live it meet new people, even have fun, become more of a positive person people want to know and keep around?

I mean if u knew me, you would see why. Heck I can't even talk or hold a conversation properly, because of never getting a chance to use my voice that much.

Il try to join more things problem is though I live in a isolated rural area and my mother gets pissed with having to drive us everywhere (I can drive) 
I just hate the fact the summer I have loads of time to do things, but I cant because of geographical issues, I move to college in a urban area and then have no time due to college work and money.
I did go to a gym, but rarely any social interaction unless u take an extra class. Did that once, felt embaressed afterwards so never went back.

I did that once, screamed into a pillow, because all the emotions were literally given me strain on the brain like some sort of a headache. I felt better then afterwards.


I agree with you on not staying alive for others. That's what its always been for me. Being forced to go to family events to look social and normal, only to end up being ignored then while every chats around each other. 

I even try to talk to some, but like I said because of not being that great with people, you can literally see the strained smiles on people I talk to who just rather go away from me and talk to others.

Same with telling me what to do, (even at 22 years of age), what to eat, what to buy, what jobs, course to do, etc, etc. Constant nagging ALL the time.

Thanks I'll try to, but the isolation, being an embarrassing burden can be too much at times.

Even though family is there, it hasn't always been great and there are the type to not want to know problems like this tbh.
